name: Thought Crisp #18
description:
A snack dispensed in a vintage-style brown paper bag marked with Vietnamese text. Contains a handful of brittle, round crisps. When consumed, these crisps induce momentary memory confusion and feelings of nostalgia disconnected from the consumer's actual experiences.

EFFECT: Consumption causes temporary lapses in short-term memory and an overwhelming sense of nostalgia for an indeterminate time and place.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Exposing the snack to air creates visual distortions around the bag.
TASTE: Papery with a hint of roasted peanuts.
PACKAGING: A small, unassuming brown paper bag with faded blue and red print. The front reads "Thought Crisp" in Vietnamese. Simple geometric patterns decorate the edges, with faded glyphs lining the bottom.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Might be suitable for sentiment marketing—if you don't mind the memory gaps.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-14 — edition #18 of the permanent record.
